title: SSH MCP Server configuration
description: Targets the SSH MCP server may connect to. Secrets are never stored here: passwords and key passphrases are referenced by environment variable name.

$schema.description: Editor hint; ignored by the server.

id.description: Unique id; the serverId every tool call uses.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the password (not the password itself).

privateKeyPassphraseEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the key passphrase.

knownHostsPath.description: known_hosts file; required while strictHostKeyChecking is true.

connectTimeoutMs.description: TCP connect + SSH handshake + authentication timeout.

commandTimeoutMs.description: Default and maximum ssh_exec / SFTP operation timeout.

maxOutputBytes.description: Cap per stdout/stderr stream and per SFTP read/write.

allowedCommandPrefixes.description: When non-empty, commands must start with one of these at a word boundary and shell metacharacters are rejected.

deniedCommandRegexes.description: Regular expressions; any match rejects the command. Use the RE2/Java-compatible subset.
